text: The EDG shall be rated for the standby (ESP) rating at the site ambient (DP-CASE-0008, 40 degC) and altitude, and have a day tank and fuel storage for at least 8 hours at rated load, refilled from the LDO system. The EDG shall be in an enclosure or room in the marine atmosphere with filtered combustion air (ER-02.10 salt loads).
